_doc: The PICK YOUR PLAYER screen's LANDMARK STARTS (owner, Nov 18): start at a named landmark instead of your house. Derived from the game's own named places — areas.json heroes kind=poi (Ledo Pizza, Atholton HS, Reservoir HS) and data/places.json (Weis, Gringada, the 108 Astro setpiece). x/y is the landmark's point in world units (footprint centroid; Atholton = roster.meetup.pos, the school lot; the Astro = its setpiece spot). The spawn snaps to the nearest road point via roadInfo/nearPt (the jumpTo pattern in src/main.js), so a car never starts inside a footprint. Houses stay in the person picker — landmarks only. If a POI is added to areas.json or places.json, add it here too or the picker won't offer it.
